item.name: FreightUtils
item.summary: Dangerous goods, freight calculators, customs codes and duty, locations and equipment for logistics workflows, each answer with its source.
item.description:
Freight reference data and calculators for your workflows and AI agents, from FreightUtils: dangerous goods (ADR 2025 and 2027), loading metres, CBM, chargeable weight, pallet fitting, ISO 14083 / GLEC emissions, HS codes, UK and EU duty, Incoterms 2020, UN/LOCODE, airports, airlines, containers, ULDs and vehicles, and container, air waybill and IMO number checks.

Every one of the 40 operations of the FreightUtils API has its own step, with everyday shortcuts for a UN number, an HS code, a location code, a container number and an air waybill. Each answer carries its source line, so values can be stored, shown and cited with it. Every step reads; none changes anything. Works without an account (25 requests a day) or with a free or Pro FreightUtils API key.
item.setup_summary: Add a FreightUtils connection; paste a free or Pro API key for more requests, or leave it empty to start with 25 requests a day.
